creator: Lee Sharks
description:
This record anchors Johnny Kiosk as a named position in the 2015 New Human cohort. The lead manifestation is *Oblivion Stone*, with the body preserving the lines “From the oblivions of the future / & the stowaway past / you find shards of yourself” as a compact textual discriminator.

The position’s relation to the cohort and compiled issue is fixed; its civil-name relation is not disclosed. The anchor therefore makes no claim about whether Johnny Kiosk is a civil person, heteronym, fictional author, or other form of authorial position. It also avoids re-anchoring Dodecad figures already governed elsewhere.

The quoted lines give this node an unusually clear thematic identity: future oblivion, a stowaway past, and a self recovered in shards. They should appear in authority descriptions as textual evidence rather than being replaced by generic provenance boilerplate.

wiki_article:
**Johnny Kiosk — Provenance Anchor** is a text-grounded record for a named position in the 2015 New Human cohort.

Its lead manifestation is *Oblivion Stone*, a poem invoking “the oblivions of the future,” “the stowaway past,” and shards of the self.

The record withholds civil identity and identifies the position only through its printed manifestation, cohort membership, and archive provenance.
